question: 一共有多少个客户？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

question: 一共有多少个商品？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products

question: 状态为已取消（cancelled）的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: 各个下单渠道的订单数分别是多少？
sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY n DESC

question: 客户等级（level）各有几人？
sql: SELECT level, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY level ORDER BY n DESC

question: 所有支付记录的平均金额是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM payments

question: 打 5 星的评论有多少条？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5

question: 注册城市为北京的客户有多少人？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE city = '北京'

question: 当前在售（on_sale）的商品有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products WHERE status = 'on_sale'

question: 所有评论的平均评分是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews

question: 不同支付方式的支付笔数分别是多少？
sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY n DESC

question: 各快递公司承运的包裹数量分别是多少？
sql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY n DESC

question: 2024 年一共产生了多少笔订单？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

question: 所有商品的平均售价是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products

question: 评论内容为「包装破损」的记录有多少条？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reviews WHERE content = '包装破损'

question: 各订单状态的订单数分别是多少？
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

question: 每个品类下有多少个商品？
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(p.id) AS n FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY n DESC

question: 下单次数最多的 10 位客户是谁？
sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10

question: 按支付金额统计，销售额最高的 10 个商品是哪些？
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN payments pa ON pa.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.id LIMIT 10

question: 每个品类的销售额（按支付金额）分别是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN payments pa ON pa.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: 2025 年每个月的订单数是多少？
sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 各个下单渠道的平均支付金额是多少？
sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(AVG(pa.amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM payments pa JOIN orders o ON o.id = pa.order_id GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY avg_amount DESC

question: 还没有支付记录的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments pa ON pa.order_id = o.id WHERE pa.id IS NULL

question: 支付总额最高的 5 个城市是哪些？
sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(pa.amount), 2) AS total FROM payments pa JOIN orders o ON o.id = pa.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: 评论数最多的 10 个商品是哪些？
sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(r.id) AS n FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY n DESC, p.id LIMIT 10

question: 不同客户等级的平均支付金额分别是多少？
sql: SELECT c.level, ROUND(AVG(pa.amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM payments pa JOIN orders o ON o.id = pa.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY avg_amount DESC

question: 2026 年每个月的支付总额是多少？
sql: SELECT substr(pa.paid_at, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(pa.amount), 2) AS total FROM payments pa WHERE pa.paid_at >= '2026-01-01' AND pa.paid_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 退款订单（refunded）占全部订单的比例是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct FROM orders

question: 各快递公司的平均送达天数（下单到签收）是多少？
sql: SELECT s.carrier, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_at) - julianday(o.order_date)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.id = s.order_id GROUP BY s.carrier ORDER BY avg_days

question: 销量（件数）最高的 5 个商品是哪些？
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY qty DESC, p.id LIMIT 5

question: 每个品类的商品平均售价是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY avg_price DESC

question: 每个订单平均包含多少件商品？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt), 2) AS avg_items FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS cnt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: 各渠道的退款订单数分别是多少？
sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY n DESC

question: 2025 年注册的客户有多少人？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-01-01' AND signup_date < '2026-01-01'

question: 支付总额最高的客户叫什么名字，总额是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(pa.amount), 2) AS total FROM payments pa JOIN orders o ON o.id = pa.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total DESC, c.id LIMIT 1

question: 下单次数达到 10 次及以上的客户有多少人？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10)

question: 每个品类中销量最高的商品是哪个？
sql: SELECT category, name, qty FROM (SELECT c.name AS category, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, p.id) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, p.id) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY category

question: 每位客户最近一次下单的日期是什么时候？（只列出有订单的客户）
sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY last_order DESC, c.id LIMIT 20

question: 从来没有下过单的客户有多少人？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL

question: 各城市的复购率（下单 2 次及以上的客户占比）是多少？
sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) t ON t.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY repeat_rate DESC

question: 哪些渠道的平均支付金额高于全站平均？
sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(avg_amount, 2) AS avg_amount FROM (SELECT o.channel AS channel, AVG(pa.amount) AS avg_amount FROM payments pa JOIN orders o ON o.id = pa.order_id GROUP BY o.channel) WHERE avg_amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM payments) ORDER BY avg_amount DESC

question: 各品类的销售额占总销售额的比例分别是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) FROM order_items), 2) AS pct FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY pct DESC

question: 支付金额与订单明细合计金额不一致的订单有多少笔？（差异超过 0.01 元）
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT o.id, pa.amount AS paid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS calc FROM orders o JOIN payments pa ON pa.order_id = o.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id HAVING ABS(pa.amount - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount))) > 0.01)

question: 平均评分最低的商品是哪一个？它的评论数是多少？
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY avg_rating ASC, p.id LIMIT 1

question: 每个月有多少位不同的客户下过单？
sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 客户首次购买与第二次购买的平均间隔天数是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap), 2) AS avg_days FROM (SELECT customer_id, julianday(order_date) - julianday(LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date)) AS gap FROM orders) WHERE gap IS NOT NULL

question: 各客户等级的平均订单笔数是多少？
sql: SELECT c.level, ROUND(AVG(t.n), 2) AS avg_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) t ON t.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY avg_orders DESC

question: 支付总额最高的 3 个城市中，销量最高的商品是哪个？
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN payments pa ON pa.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE c.city IN (SELECT c2.city FROM payments pa2 JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = pa2.order_id JOIN customers c2 ON c2.id = o2.customer_id GROUP BY c2.city ORDER BY SUM(pa2.amount) DESC LIMIT 3) GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY qty DESC, p.id LIMIT 1

question: 下单次数最多的前 3 位客户一共贡献了多少件商品？
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3)

question: 每个月的新客户数与当月订单数相比，哪个月的订单客户比最高？
sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyers, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 3) AS ratio FROM orders o GROUP BY month ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 1
